title: Storage failure and recovery
steps: Use storage.failNext(operation, path) before a save, autosave, Settings Apply, Load, deletion or export, then retry through the same UI.
Use storage.holdNext('readTextFile', path), select another snapshot, then storage.release(id) to inspect stale-read isolation.
Open variant=startup-session to reject the first session checkpoint, then navigate and reload to verify later persistence.
Use storage.operations() to inspect exact paths and outcomes; storage.reset() clears faults and cancels pending operations. Journey reset restores the original files.
